origin.description: Parametric bootstrap of the Pickands exponent. The draws are R's rexp.
origin.details: Parametric bootstrap of the Pickands exponent. The draws are R's rexp.
origin.example:
set.seed(1)
P <- Pickands(y ~ x1 + x2, tau=0.1, data=df)
as.numeric(summary(P, B=3)$z)

translation.description: Parametric bootstrap of the Pickands exponent. The draws are R's rexp.
translation.details: Parametric bootstrap of the Pickands exponent. The draws are R's rexp.
translation.example:
from quantreg import pickands, summary_pickands
set_seed(1)
P = pickands("y ~ x1 + x2", 0.1, data)
return summary_pickands(P, b=3)["z"]
